$Comment: Keeps a boss bound into the Boss slot whatever form he takes: each tick, any NPC of BossGroups in reach is locked into the slot. A boss who changes role mid-fight comes back as a new entity, and this is what holds the fight on him. The Orbis boss template runs it in every phase; list every form of the boss in his group.

BossGroups.Description: NPC groups holding the boss in every form.

Range.Description: How far from the script's entity the boss is looked for.
